tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: This project provides a comprehensive engine and UI for Qi Men Dun Jia (奇门遁甲) divination. It supports multiple 'families' (Time, Day, Month, Year Jia) and features a transition from a traditional monolithic architecture to a modern, decoupled design.

tour.title: Domain Entities
tour.description: The core of the project is the domain layer, which defines pure metaphysical entities like the QiMen Pan (the plate), Gong (palaces), and Ju (the specific divination outcome). These are independent of any framework or UI.

tour.title: Data Sources
tour.description: Data is sourced from static JSON files containing metaphysical mappings (stars, doors, gods) and dynamic calculators that implement the complex time-based algorithms of Qi Men Dun Jia.

tour.title: Dual-Architecture UI (Legacy vs Modern)
tour.description: Compare the legacy traditional approach—a monolithic single-file view—with the modern Clean Architecture implementation using MVVM, UseCases, and a dedicated Design System in the redesign_ui module.
